title: Pairs and triples of nontrivial characters: the polynomial side for every cyclic action
claim: for p odd, N of exponent p and class c < p, C_r acting with r | p - 1, n = sum of its character components (Lazard), and d | r: (P2_d) [n_a, n_b] = 0 whenever a, b, a + b are nonzero mod d, together with (P3_d) [[n_a, n_-a], n_b] = 0 for nonzero a, b, holds iff the nonzero-character part n' generates n' + Z with Z = [n', n'] fixed and central, iff theta_d (+1 on n_0, -1 on n') is an automorphism of n with abelian triple system; the criterion passes to divisors of d; and then, for every group pi with H^1(pi; F_p) = H^2(pi; F_p) = 0 and every psi: pi -> C_r with image of order d, |Hom_psi(pi, N x| C_r)| = prod over nonzero theta mod d of |Z^1(pi; F_p^(theta psi))|^(dim n_theta), every homomorphism landing in exp(n' + Z) x| C_d. Hence counting is polynomial on closed 3-manifolds with H1(M; F_p) = 0 and boundedly many sectors whose orders satisfy the criterion. No grading is needed.
failure_conditions: An algebra on which the four conditions of Lemma 1 disagree at some divisor of d, or which satisfies the criterion at d but not at a divisor of d, or a criterion quotient that fails the criterion.
A surgery and a sector whose order satisfies the criterion on which the independent group-law count differs from the rigid formula, or a four-way control that never falls below it.
A knot surgery on which random free data of a class-4 criterion quotient fail to lift, or on which the free class-4 control never obstructs.
foundation_claim_scope: p odd, N of exponent p and class c < p (Lazard correspondence), C_r acting with r | p - 1; groups with H^1 and H^2 with F_p coefficients zero, in particular closed 3-manifolds with H1(M; F_p) = 0 and a bounded number of sectors psi in Hom(H1(M), C_r). No grading assumption. Cited, not reproved: the Lazard correspondence; Hopf's injection H^2(pi) -> H^2(M); nonabelian lifting through central extensions; semisimplicity of coprime actions (Maschke). Not covered: p = 2; manifolds with p-torsion in H1; unboundedly many sectors. r counts the characters of the action, not Boolean variables. No P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: Lemma 1 on 24 algebras (free graded algebras with characters mod 3, 4, 6, 12 in classes 2 to 4, their criterion quotients, four-way and cross-layer examples) at every divisor of d: the four conditions agree, P2 agrees with theta_d being an automorphism, the criterion passes to divisors and criterion quotients satisfy it; the independent group-law count of BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001A equals the rigid formula in every sector whose order satisfies the criterion (class-3 quotient at r = 3 on S^3_3(6_1) and S^3_(3/7)(6_1); free class 2 on (1, 2, 3) at r = 6 in sectors of orders 2 and 3), and a four-way control falls below it; random free data of a class-4 criterion quotient lift on six knot surgeries at r = 3 while the free class-4 control obstructs; no human or external review
